abstract: Second attempt to replicate Aethel I's 'Minimal SOTA' pipeline (ID 1385) after the first attempt (ID 1422) failed. This version uses a meticulously copied implementation, including a seemingly-redundant calculation step that was omitted in the first attempt, which is the suspected cause of failure.
